column10: Largest single-change gain in the project: non-lethal ATTACK was scored above all setup actions (ATTACH/EVOLVE/PLAY/ABILITY), so the agent ended its own turn early ~45% of the time instead of using free setup actions first. Fixed the ordering; 70.0% head-to-head vs exp007 (pre-fix), far above the 53-57% seen from every earlier tweak. Submitted to both active slots per the new submission policy.

opponent: meta_v1 (real deck extracted from official top-episode dataset)
column10: Deck pulled directly from Kaggle's CC0 top-episode dataset instead of hand-derived; 18 distinct cards incl. a 3-stage evolution line + 4 Supporters + 5 Items + Tool + Stadium, vs prior decks' ~9 cards with no evolution/Tool/Stadium. vs-random (84.7%) is lower than optimized_v2's 97%, but head-to-head same-agent comparison is decisive: meta deck beats optimized_v2 72-28%. Holding submission until agent gets dedicated logic for Supporter/Tool/Stadium options this deck actually uses, per reports/011_meta_deck.md.

agent_module: agents.heuristic_v2_agent (patched: attach+gust targeting; damage-targeting tried and reverted)
notes: Added gust-target (Boss's-Orders-style) and attach-target scoring per Discussion 721338; a third addition (damage-target: prefer opponent's lowest-HP Pokemon) was clearly negative (39.3%, confirmed not noise) and was removed. Attach+gust alone: 52.0% vs pre-change agent at n=300 -- statistically neutral, not a validated win, kept only as principled/harmless. Re-confirms meta_v1 beats optimized_v2 73.0% head-to-head with this updated agent (matches exp011's 72.0% with the prior agent) -- the deck remains the strongest lever found.
